name: Deepworks front gate padlock
notes: The padlock on the boarded mine gate's front door (mw-e26.2): a thief with lockpicks can pick it (tier 2), and Vane's key is the social route (bible 4.1 beat 5). No key item exists yet; the gate puzzle that writes deepworks.gate-open and opens the way is mw-e25.10.
hint: A rusted padlock on a chain. Vane's seal is stamped in the wax.
